text:
Marta: Quick follow-up from the all-hands around hiring & org changes. Short version: we're not pausing hiring entirely but shifting how new external reqs are evaluated. Posting the concrete rules below so managers know what to do immediately.

Devon: quick pulse check  does this touch internal transfers?

Marta: Internal moves are still encouraged. We want to prioritize moving people where possible before opening external searches. Managers: please flag candidates with `internal_candidate` in Greenhouse and note coverage plans.

People Ops: Immediate actions for managers: 1) Mark any open req that is not customer/SLA/infra as `hold_external`; 2) For roles you think must continue, add a 22-sentence business impact justification into the req notes; 3) If you need a fast-track for an internal candidate, tag `fast-track-internal`. We'll review daily.

Hiring Lead: For reqs mid-process (offer extended / final interviews), should we pause?

Marta: If candidate is at offer or final-stage and role maps to revenue, infra, or security, continue. For other roles, pause external offers and check with People Ops. We9ll honor candidate commitments where we already made formal offers.

Anika: Are we changing compensation or leveling policy during this?

CTO: No changes to comp bands or the hiring bar. We are tightening headcount allocation, not candidate quality. Any edge-case leveling questions ping Talent.

Devon: Any special buckets or pools to cover immediate capacity?

People Ops: Yes  we are launching a 6-person "flex operations" pool to temporarily cover high-severity infra and customer incidents and enable teams to stagger leaves/backfills. That pool will be staffed from existing approved headcount and centrally dispatched during critical events.

Marta: On contractor conversions  we will default to contract extensions unless the role clearly reduces cost or is strategic. Submit a short cost-justification doc if you want conversion approved.

Hiring Lead: What does the approval flow look like now for new external hires?

People Ops: New external reqs above L4 require: manager justification + a one-paragraph business impact + approvals from Org Head + Finance. Expect ~72h turnaround. L1-L4 follow standard flow but still need the `hold_external` check.

Recruiting Bot: Shared: https://redwood.internal/headcount-plan-2026-v4 (internal)  snapshot=1962345599

Anika: Do we have a fallback plan if QBR metrics require further tightening?

Marta: We'll reassess in next leadership sync. If further tightening needed, we'll prioritize SLA/revenue/infra first, then product experiments. We'll keep communication weekly and aim for minimal disruption.

Devon: Thanks  can People Ops post a short checklist managers can copy into their team docs?

People Ops: Will do. Posting a one-pager + a Greenhouse tagging script by EOD. Also running a 30-minute office hour tomorrow 10:30am for any manager walkthroughs.

Marta: Appreciate the quick questions. If you have specific cases (promotions tied to hiring plans, urgent conversions), DM me or People Ops and we9ll triage.
